run_sweep_workload: run the vLLM sweep workload CLI to explore latency-throughput tradeoffs for different workload levels
explore_comb_workloads: explore workload iterations by running serial and batch inference with interpolated intermediate workload values
run_comb_workload: run a single workload combination by setting the workload variable to a specific value and executing the benchmark
estimate_workload_value: estimate the workload value from benchmark run data using request throughput and mean end-to-end latency
build_sweep_args: build a SweepServeWorkloadArgs dataclass instance from CLI arguments for workload sweep configuration
